## Kind of change

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit message follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix(sync): …`); the `commits` check enforces it
- [ ] The branch is rebased onto the current `main`; no merge commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `go test ./...` passes in `tool/`
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/`, `SPEC.md`, `DESIGN.md`) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No song content (audio, video, lyrics, txt files) except Creative Commons material with its license
